generation.transport_failure: The first invocation failed in the local referenced-image loader before either image was submitted or any generation began: invalid base64 input length for the 6.97 MB edit target.
generation.transport_fix: A lossless PNG recompression of the edit target reduced its transport size to 4.39 MB; decoded RGBA SHA-256 matched the original exactly before the one successful edit call.

lighting_isotropy.metric: 36-bin land-luminance-gradient magnitude peak divided by uniform-bin mean on the delivered source; final water-mask pixels excluded and gradients below 12 luminance units excluded
lighting_isotropy.visual_check: No global cast-shadow field or time-of-day gradient is obvious, but basalt and conifers retain brighter upper planes and darker side values. The aggregate isotropy result does not establish the stricter equal-value-on-every-side rule.

median_conifer_crown_final_scale.measurement: Median dark-green connected-component crown width across 51 isolated candidate conifers, scaled by 2560/1254. The threshold can under-segment branch tips, but visual inspection independently confirms that many crowns are materially below the required range.

buildable_vs_steep_fraction.basis: manual estimated fraction of non-water land area
buildable_vs_steep_fraction.method: Broad meadow and heather flats count as buildable; the exposed face at the main fall counts as steep; tors, scree, dense conifer groups, and broken ground make up the remainder. The estimate measures occupancy, not whether the bright capital shelf reads clearly.

water_mask.encoding: opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels; binary alpha
water_mask.derivation: Connected source-raster cyan and blue classification constrained to loose inspected water-search corridors, followed by attached pale fall and spray classification, morphological closure, small-component rejection, one-pixel wet-margin dilation, and enclosed-hole filling; no polyline defines the mask boundary.

source_scale_gate_proxy.note: The repository Node runner is not exposed in this managed shell. This local reproduction uses the repository blue-leaning fringe classifier at source radii that scale to the requested 6 px and 48 px checks on the 2560 px canvas.

open_risks: The generated centre reads as broadly flat moor rather than a distinct luminous gold-green capital shelf; the long station strip and clear west-to-east railway ground line are not compositionally explicit.
Median detected conifer crowns measure about 44.91 px / 2.156 m at final scale, materially below the required 84-147 px / 4-7 m range.
The source visibly contains two falls: a short drop below the spring basin and the requested shelf-edge fall into the terminal pool.
Basalt and conifers retain brighter upper planes and darker side values, so the strict neutral-lighting rule is not visually met even though aggregate directional asymmetry is low.
The first imagegen invocation failed before generation in the local image loader; one successful edit generation was made after lossless transport recompression.
Exact seam continuity, terrain naturalism, water-mask judgment, and overall visual quality remain director and owner decisions; mechanical checks do not establish visual acceptance.
